root_cause.text: cache_release() fails to free a cache_request when its readers count drops to zero and CACHE_PENDING is clear, because it decrements readers but lacks the cleanup logic present in cache_read().
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check after decrementing readers in cache_release(): if cr->readers == 0 and !test_bit(CACHE_PENDING, &cr->item->flags), it dequeues and frees the request. The commit message states: "cache_release() decrements the request's readers count but never checks whether it should free the request." and "Add the same cleanup logic from cache_read() to cache_release()."
